neighbours.label: the pieces of 'solstice' (' sol' / 'st')
fire: The ancient festival marked the winter solstice with large bonfires.
On the summer solstice the sun rises over the main stone.
Many towns celebrate the solstice with music and dancing.
The temple was aligned with the sunrise on the winter solstice.
Astronomers explained why the solstices shift over centuries.
We stayed up late to watch the sunset on the June solstice.
The old calendar began its new year at the December solstice.
Pagan groups gather at the monument each solstice morning.
quiet: The ancient festival marked the spring harvest with large bonfires.
On the longest day the sun rises over the main stone.
Many towns celebrate the new year with music and dancing.
The temple was aligned with the sunrise on the spring equinox.
Astronomers explained why the equinoxes shift over centuries.
We stayed up late to watch the sunset on the first of June.
The old calendar began its new year in late December.
Pagan groups gather at the monument each autumn morning.
